True Statement: By inducing dormancy, ABA helps seeds to withstand desiccation and other factors unfavourable for growth.
False 1: By inducing germination, gibberellin helps seeds to withstand desiccation and other factors unfavourable for growth.
FIB 1: By inducing dormancy, ___ helps seeds to withstand desiccation and other factors unfavourable for growth.
FIB 2: By inducing dormancy, ABA helps seeds to withstand ___ and other factors unfavourable for growth.
FIB 3: By inducing dormancy, ABA helps seeds to withstand desiccation and other factors ___ for growth.
Reason: ABA-induced dormancy allows seeds to survive dry winters; it prevents precocious germination (vivipary) while the seed is still on the parent plant.
